title: Sherpa voice WASM bundle smoke test (web)

wait-wasm-ready.expression: (function(){return new Promise(function(resolve){var i=0;function tick(){if(typeof window.SherpaOnnx==='object' && typeof window.SherpaOnnx.ASR==='object' && typeof window.SherpaOnnx.ASR.loadModel==='function'){resolve({ready:true,asrKeys:Object.keys(window.SherpaOnnx.ASR),topLevelKeys:Object.keys(window.SherpaOnnx)});return;}i++;if(i>=120){resolve({ready:false,reason:'timeout',i:i});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()

verify-cohere-symbols.expression: (async function(){const r=await fetch('/wasm/sherpa-onnx-wasm-combined.wasm');const buf=await r.arrayBuffer();const bytes=new Uint8Array(buf);const decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:false});const text=decoder.decode(bytes);return {sizeBytes:buf.byteLength,hasCohere:text.includes('cohere-transcribe'),hasQwen3:text.includes('qwen3-asr')};})()

verify-qwen3-symbols.expression: (async function(){const r=await fetch('/wasm/sherpa-onnx-wasm-combined.wasm');const buf=await r.arrayBuffer();const bytes=new Uint8Array(buf);const decoder=new TextDecoder('utf-8',{fatal:false});const text=decoder.decode(bytes);return {sizeBytes:buf.byteLength,hasQwen3:text.includes('qwen3-asr')};})()
